messages:
Anna: quick q — for /generate are we going to split validation into 422 vs 4xx generic? existing clients treat missing prompt as 400, want to avoid breaking canary
Matt: oof we should be careful. why 422 vs 400?
Anna: idea was 422 = semantic validation (e.g. prompt too long / bad format), 400 = syntactic (malformed json). But lots of customers just check 4xx vs 5xx
Priya: +1 on being conservative. If we change codes we need to update SDKs and docs. keeping 400 for client errors but adding a machine-readable error.code seems lower risk.
Samir: also need retry semantics. 4xx should generally be non-retryable, but some 4xx (rate limit) are transient. we should expose retryable: true/false in the payload
Anna: exactly. proposal: keep status 400 for all client errors for backward compat, include error.type / error.code / retryable in body. example:```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "validation_error",
    "message": "prompt is required",
    "code": "validation_missing_prompt",
    "retryable": false
  }
}
```
Matt: that seems sane. SDKs can map error.code -> typed exception. avoids breaking people who only check status code
Priya: question: how do we represent rate-limit? currently we return 429 with Retry-After. keep 429 for rate-limit and set retryable: true in body?
Samir: yes keep 429 for rate-limit. important distinction: 429 = transient, 5xx = server issue, 400 = client issue (non-transient unless code says otherwise), and body.retryable overrides for edge cases
DeployBot: notice: canary for /generate schema change scheduled 2025-06-10T03:00:00Z — will log any non-200/429 responses
Anna: action items: I'll update docs + open API PR with example payload and migration notes. Matt — can you add mapping to JS SDK? Priya — can you take Go SDK?
Matt: yep i'll add a simple Error class and tests, will ping when done :+1:
Priya: on it, will add mapping and ensure clients read error.retryable
Samir: should we add a short-lived deprecation note that we may introduce 422 in v2 and encourage clients to check error.code?
Anna: good call. I'll add a note in the API changelog and the migration guide. not planning to flip codes now
Matt: LGTM
Priya: LGTM
Anna: thanks everyone — closing the loop here. i'll post PR links once live :raised_hands:
